title: hyperannotatR: Multi-layer region-of-interest annotation for images and spectral cubes
description: hyperannotatR provides tools for annotating regions of interest across whole-slide microscopy images, hyperspectral data cubes and conventional raster images. Annotations are held as validated simple-feature geometries in image pixel coordinates with explicit pyramid-level transforms, so that a region drawn at one zoom level remains correct at every other. Regions can be rasterised into binary, labelled or multi-class integer masks for use in downstream segmentation and classification work. A batch annotation application supports resumable sessions across queues of images, live mask preview, and export to GeoJSON, QuPath and TIFF. It is aimed at researchers preparing ground-truth labels for biomedical image analysis.
